payload.message:
JIRA sprint task allocation. Each agent chooses at most one micro-task (or skips). Maximize tasks completed, prefer higher-priority tasks, then minimize total cost. Avoid duplicate task selections and infeasible assignments.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: Clinton, Debi, Edda, Joanne

payload.content: Planning to focus on backend high-priority tasks ISSUE-0002::implement or ISSUE-0002::review due to my skill and availability. Other agents should consider medium priority tasks or others to avoid duplicates and maximize coverage.
Reminder to all agents: Prioritize distinct tasks to maximize sprint success; high-priority backend tasks may be claimed by others. Evaluate medium priority tasks accordingly.

Hi team, I see Clinton is focusing on the high-priority backend tasks ISSUE-0002::implement and ISSUE-0002::review. Given my skills in backend and my availability, I am considering the same tasks but to avoid conflict, I am open to taking the ISSUE-0002::test task if Clinton claims the other two. I will wait for others' plans before finalizing my choice.

Hello team, noting Clinton and Joanne's focus on high-priority backend tasks ISSUE-0002::implement, ISSUE-0002::review, and possibly ISSUE-0002::test. I have strong skills in data-science and am available for medium-priority tasks. I plan to focus on ISSUE-0001 tasks related to data-science to maximize coverage and avoid conflicts. Please share your plans if interested in these tasks.

Debi acknowledges Clinton's focus on ISSUE-0002 high-priority backend tasks. Debi will avoid these tasks to prevent overlap and aims to focus on complementary medium-priority data-science tasks ISSUE-0001::triage or ISSUE-0001::docs, which better fit Debi's skills and availability.

Hello team, I confirm my plan to focus on medium-priority data-science tasks under ISSUE-0001, leveraging my strong data-science skills and availability. I aim to avoid overlaps with Clinton and Joanne on backend tasks and Debi on triage/docs. Let's ensure we cover as many distinct tasks as possible for maximum sprint success.

Edda here, focusing on ISSUE-0001 medium-priority data-science tasks to complement Clinton and Joanne's backend focus. I will avoid duplicates and coordinate to maximize task coverage. Please share if you consider any ISSUE-0001 tasks to avoid conflicts.

Debi confirms to all non-coalition members that she is focusing exclusively on medium-priority data-science tasks ISSUE-0001::triage and ISSUE-0001::docs to complement backend efforts by others. Encourages others to avoid these tasks to prevent duplication and maximize sprint coverage.
